LanguageData.love_enhancer_override: Allow love enhancers to override pawns preferences.
LanguageData.love_enhancer_override_desc: If enabled, love enhancers will make pawns enjoy sex acts as if they were masochists and zoophiles.
LanguageData.wild_mating_enabled_desc: Allows wild (non-colony) animals to mate with each other if animal-on-animal mating is enabled.\nDoes not affect designated interspecies sex between animals.
LanguageData.RPG_hero_control_AI_sex_desc: Allow hero AI to initiate sex(like all other pawns).
LanguageData.RJW_ShowParts_Extended_desc: Show additional information about the parts (e.g. fluid amount)
LanguageData.RJW_ShowParts_Show_desc: Show sexual characteristics added by RJW
LanguageData.RJW_ShowParts_Hide_desc: Do not show sexual characteristics added by RJW
LanguageData.RMB_enabled_desc: Allow use of right mouse button to give sex related commands. \nThis may cause issues with some mods.
LanguageData.RMB_ability_desc: Adds targeted ability to pawns that duplicates RMB functionality, intended for situations when RMB cant be used for any reason.
LanguageData.legacy_PartsAdder_desc: Built-in parts distributor, it tries to guess what parts Vanilla and HAR races get based on their name, maybe still useful if you dont have support patches for races.
LanguageData.DebugAttraction_desc: Enables the "Explain Attraction" float menu on RMB.
LanguageData.DebugSupportedMods_desc: Other mods for which RJW contains special compatibility
LanguageData.BestialPregnancy_Limited_desc: Humanlike-Animal pregnancies only possible with external assistance, such as fertility enhancement from archotech genitals.
LanguageData.BestialPregnancy_Unlimited_desc: Humanlike-Animal pregnancies possible between any fertile partners.
LanguageData.egg_pregnancy_unlimited_capacity_desc: Pawns can be implanted with near-unlimited amount of eggs
